description.value: Mama's Japanese Kitchen is a small, no-reservations Japanese restaurant situated at the Harbour Spirit Centre on the corner of Madeira Park Road and Highway 101 in Madeira Park. The kitchen uses no MSG or peanuts and offers both dine-in and takeout, including a signature Big Tray sushi platter available with advance ordering. It is a locally-run spot serving authentic Japanese cuisine in a small Sunshine Coast community, making it a notable meal stop for cyclists travelling the Highway 101 corridor.
